LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Exalted.label: revered
LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Exalted.description: Giant ants are models of endurance, discipline, and loyalty to the colony. Killing one is a grave failure unless no other path remains.
LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Despised.label: vermin
LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Despised.description: Giant ants are a mutant plague. Their nests must be burned before the colony spreads.
LanguageData.VME_IdeoRole_InsectoidHerder.label: AntAgonizer
LanguageData.VME_IdeoRole_InsectoidHerder.description: An AntAgonizer is a specialist in giant-ant behavior, pheromone conditioning, and hive handling. They can pacify wild ants and establish controlled jelly-producing nests, but their ritual obligations and constant work with the colony prevent them from performing most ordinary labor.
LanguageData.VME_InsectoidHymnPrecept.label: call of the colony
LanguageData.VME_InsectoidHymnPrecept.description: A ritual call built from chittering rhythms, pheromone smoke, and the AntAgonizer's sermon. A successful call refreshes the AntAgonizer's Establish Ant Nest ability. The best possible result also drives off ordinary giant ants currently assaulting the settlement.
